requirements.requirement: 7.1 Build orchestration contracts only on top of the Phase-0–6 CLI: worker roles, job ticket, job graph, handoff envelope, assignment, review verdict and execution ledger. Existing S0–S5 stages stay valid.
requirements.assessment: Typed contracts wrap S0–S5; required knowledge/probe/risk/approval/evaluator job extensions absent (F2). Core context is indirectly bound in task/plan/lease/receipt, not all metadata absent.

requirements.requirement: 7.2 Implement a coordinator that selects roles based on manifest capabilities, budgets and dependency DAG; it may call real host subagents where available or execute role workflows sequentially through the same CLI.
requirements.assessment: Small task/capability-specific sequential DAG exists; fixed 3600 budget metadata is not consumed by coordinator. Native process policies exist independently (F4).

requirements.requirement: 7.3 Ship four minimum roles: Intent Analyst (reads original brief), Rig/Animation Artist (generates rig/clips), Animation Inspector (independent geometry and motion review) and Unity Integration Worker (imports clips). Their outputs use canonical asset IDs.
requirements.assessment: Four minimum role contracts, logical role identities and canonical asset ID handoffs exist; same host, not independent native agents.

requirements.requirement: 7.4 Separate worker planning from execution: no worker may issue arbitrary shell commands to PolyForge; all tools dispatch through capability list/show/run and the authorized runner. Strict typed JSON and run-scoped artifacts.
requirements.assessment: Strict JSON role allowlists and registered capability dispatch, run-scoped artifacts; no worker arbitrary-shell submission.

requirements.requirement: 7.5 Implement Blender 5-compatible slotted Actions, slots/channelbags, version probes, sampled keyframes, robot skeleton with named joints, weights, pivots and Idle/Walk actions.
requirements.assessment: Pinned Blender5.2.2 mechanical rigid robot family, named bones/weights, slottedActions/channelbags, sampled/reopened Idle/Walk source.

requirements.requirement: 7.6 Export the pinned robot rig and baked clips via supported FBX path. Native Unity Editor APIs create AnimatorController and link imported clips to enemy prefab.
requirements.assessment: Native FBX export/Generic-rig Unity import, linked prefab/controller clips and separate AnimationArena fixture.

requirements.requirement: 7.7 Require Inspector review for wrong left/right bone mapping, detached limbs, wrong root motion and missing Idle↔Walk state transition; record measurements and sampled frame evidence.
requirements.assessment: Motion inspector and native Editor/PlayMode fault cases detect semantic mapping, detached limbs/root drift and missing transition.

requirements.requirement: 7.8 Add worker concurrency limits, Unity single-writer lock, asset-level ownership lease and worker cancellation/resume after crash. Independent review runs under different worker identity and cannot edit the candidate under review.
requirements.assessment: Process-aware TTL/token leases/heartbeat/cancel, single Unity writer, sealed candidate and readonly logical inspector.

requirements.requirement: 7.9 Preserve every original Phase-7 fixture and run a 1-worker vs 4-role parity test: identical required game outcome, no duplicate IDs, no project corruption or tool-permission bypass.
requirements.assessment: Retained one/four-role parity compares sampled motion/native bindings, original scene unchanged; workflow parity, not4 actual models.

requirements.requirement: 7.10 Introduce task_class (EXPLAIN, INSPECT, CREATE_ASSET, ANIMATE, FIX_PROJECT, ADD_MECHANIC, BUILD_GAME) and domain_tags so unrelated requests do not always trigger the full Blender→Unity pipeline. The classifier must preserve all original user requirements.
requirements.assessment: Explicit USER_OR_HOST_CLASSIFIED task/domain preserves exact brief; explanation/Blender-only avoids Unity, supported complete game retainsS0–S5.

requirements.assessment: Single/sequential execution modes and DIFFERENT_ROLE_SAME_HOST grade; no protected evaluator/native-agent claim.

requirements.requirement: 7.13 Make job transactions idempotent: unique job and candidate revisions, atomic result commits, lease TTL/heartbeat, cancellation, Unity exclusive lock, worker crash recovery and requeue without duplicate edits.
